# hivelocity_device_ips (Data Source)

Lists the IP assignments routed to a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_device_ips" "web" {
  device_id = 12345
}

output "web_subnets" {
  value = data.hivelocity_device_ips.web.ip_assignments[*].subnet
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the device.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_assignments` (List of Object) IP assignments of the device. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_assignments))

<a id="nestedatt--ip_assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_assignments`

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `device_id` (Number)
- `dns_resolvers` (List of String)
- `facility_code` (String)
- `first_usable_ip` (String)
- `gateway_ip` (String)
- `last_usable_ip` (String)
- `netmask` (String)

- `port_id` (Number)
- `subnet` (String)
